t: Alan Twisted Beard founded the duchy in 939 after driving the Vikings out of Brittany.
Under the Montfort dukes it built near-sovereign institutions: a council, Estates, a chamber of accounts and its own coinage.
Defeat in 1488 and Anne of Brittany’s marriages to two French kings led to union with France in 1532.
dyk: The Catholicon, a Breton–French–Latin dictionary compiled in 1464 and printed at Tréguier in 1499, is the first Breton dictionary and one of the earliest of French.
